title: Final Answer Constant Pressure
description: Essential Criteria: The correct fraction of work to heat for constant pressure must be provided as 2/7.

title: Final Answer Constant Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The correct fraction of work to heat for constant temperature must be provided as 1.

title: Work Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of work done during expansion at constant pressure must be shown correctly as W = p(V2 - V1).

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Important Criteria: The change in internal energy must be correctly expressed as ΔU = Cv ΔT.

title: Heat Transfer Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between heat, work, and internal energy must be correctly applied in the fraction W/Q.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units for pressure, volume, and temperature should be consistent throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes in the calculations of work and internal energy.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all necessary factors, such as n and R, are included in the final expressions.
